newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra soars in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Astra soars in early trade.

text.p: Indonesian vehicle manufacturer PT Astra International soared in early trade on Wednesday following its revised net profit forecast for the year, brokers said.
"The news that the company had raised its net forecast for 1996 had boosted sentiment towards the stock," said Kian Guntur, a broker for Schroeders Indonesia.
Astra was up 4.71 percent, or 225 rupiah, at 4,450 rupiah on a volume of 1.5 million shares at 0250 GMT.
Brokers said both local and foreign investors were buying actively on perceptions that the company's net profit forecast for 1996 was aggressive.

"The market consensus for the full year is only 340 billion rupiah but they have revised up to 450 billion rupiah. That is really an aggressive figure but they have given strong figures to support the target, many investors like it," said one foreign analyst.
But brokers said speculation of changes in management because of an apprent takeover bid in progress for the company could be a consideration.
"The upside level will be thin because of that reason and also the current price is quite high," said one local broker.
